topic.title: Jon Bernthal's Quest: The Day the Mediterranean Ran Dry

script.full_text: Jon Bernthal's Quest: The Day the Mediterranean Ran Dry. Some stories hide in plain sight, waiting for someone to finally look a little closer. Trace it back to the very beginning, and a familiar thing starts to look strange and new. By the end, you will never quite see it the same way again.
